name: debuff
description: Make 2D browser games with debuff, an open-source TypeScript framework. Start a playable platformer or top-down adventure in a minute, then build it with tests, scenario captures and fuzzing that prove each change works.

interface.longDescription:
Make 2D browser games with debuff, an open-source TypeScript framework that handles the game loop, keyboard, touch and gamepad input, crisp pixel rendering, sound, Tiled and LDtk levels, testing and the web build.

Ask for a platformer, a top-down adventure or a blank start, and the agent scaffolds a running game in about a minute. As it builds, it proves each change with logic tests that run the real game in Node, scenario scripts with screenshot captures, and a fuzzer that plays the game with random input to find crashes and stuck states. Runtime errors come back explained: whose bug it is and which line.

You keep the creative calls: art, feel, difficulty and names. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Make me a small pixel-art platformer I can play in the browser
Add a double jump to my debuff game and prove it works with a test
Fuzz my game and fix any crashes it finds
